source.title: Regulatory Technical Standards on ICT risk management framework and on simplified ICT risk management framework
source.applicability: Specifies requirements for standard and simplified ICT risk management frameworks under DORA Articles 5 and 16, applicable to financial entities based on size, risk, and complexity

passages.text: The RTS identify the key elements that financial entities subject to the simplified regime and of lower scale, risk, size and complexity would need to have in place, setting out a simplified ICT risk management framework.
